1.text: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.

2.text: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

3.text: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

4.text: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.<sup foot_note="228260">1</sup>

footnotes.228260: - Bringing the exact measures apportioned for everything by Allāh in the course of the coming year.

5.text: Peace it is<sup foot_note="228261">1</sup> until the emergence of dawn.
